# Afro's Chicken Shop (Hillcrest)

> Fresh never-frozen flame-grilled chicken, authentic hand-cut tjips, and 5 legendary Durban basting sauces in Hillcrest, KwaZulu-Natal.

## About Us
Afro's Chicken Shop (Hillcrest) is a vibrant fast-casual restaurant located at Shop 5, The Junction, Inanda Road, Hillcrest. Known across South Africa for our fresh never-frozen steam-grilled chicken, hand-cut golden potato tjips, and unforgettable lemon and chilli bastings.

- **Website**: https://www.afroschicken-hillcrest.co.za/
- **Location**: Shop 5, The Junction, 5 Inanda Road, Hillcrest, KwaZulu-Natal, 3610, South Africa
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +27 78 905 7975 (078 905 7975)
- **Email (General Inquiries)**: info@afroschicken.co.za
- **Email (Orders & Payments)**: orders@afroschicken.co.za
- **Trading Hours**: Monday – Sunday: 9:00 AM – 7:30 PM (Open 7 days a week)
- **Service Options**: Dine-in, Takeaway collection, Local delivery across Upper Highway

## Signature Basting Flavours
1. **🍋 Lemony**: Fresh lemon infusion with zesty citrus notes and gentle herb warmth.
2. **🌶️ Mild**: Smooth savoury mild warmth with balanced spices.
3. **🍶 Barbeque (BBQ)**: Sweet, smoky, and sticky braai flame-grilled classic.
4. **🍯 Sweet Chilli**: Golden sweet honey chilli glaze with a lively kick.
5. **🔥 Hot**: Fiery, authentic Durban peri-peri chilli rush for serious heat lovers.

## Menu Highlights
- **Flame-Grilled Chicken**: Succulent Quarter, Half, and Whole Chicken flame-grilled to order with crispy caramelised skin and juicy tenderness.
- **Afro Pops & Strips**: Pure bite-sized chicken breast pops or golden breast strips served with hand-cut tjips.
- **Chicken Burgers & Rolls**: Whole flame-grilled chicken breast on artisanal rolls with fresh lettuce, tomato, and secret Afro's mayo.
- **Hand-Cut Tjips**: Hand-peeled, freshly cut real potatoes fried crisp on the outside and fluffy inside.
- **Sauces & Extras**: Extra signature basting bottles and sides.

## How to Order Online
Customers can order directly on the website:
1. Visit https://www.afroschicken-hillcrest.co.za/
2. Select your flame-grilled chicken meals, strips, or burgers, pick your basting flavour, and customize sides.
3. Choose Store Collection (Shop 5, The Junction, Hillcrest) or Upper Highway Delivery.
4. Pay securely online via PayFast, Pay on Delivery, or Cash / Card on Collection.
5. Track order dispatch live or receive updates via WhatsApp.
